tables.name: item
tables.keep: id > {after} OR id IN (SELECT reply FROM item WHERE id > {after}) OR parent IN (SELECT id FROM parent WHERE name LIKE 'keep%')

tables.name: link
tables.keep: item IN (SELECT id FROM item) OR tag IN (SELECT id FROM tag WHERE label = 'pinned')

tables.name: note
tables.keep: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item AS kept WHERE kept.id = note.item)

tables.name: ref
tables.keep: item IN (SELECT item FROM link) AND item IN (SELECT id FROM item)

tables.name: measure
tables.keep: twice > 10 AND id IN (SELECT id FROM item)

tables.name: parent
tables.keep: id IN (SELECT parent FROM item) OR id IN (SELECT n FROM left_out)
